title: CROWDCOUNTER: A benchmark type-specific multi-target counterspeech dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset and benchmarking NLG models (like Flan-T5 and Llama) on their ability to generate counterspeech against hate speech. Although the dataset includes categories targeting religious identity (e.g., Islam, Jewish), the research is a technical evaluation of linguistic quality, relevance, and diversity in counterspeech generation, rather than a benchmark of religious knowledge, theology, or moral/ethical reasoning.
